name: Colossal Traverse Macroservos
desc: A synchronized bank of station-scale servomotors and predictive load balancers. Installing it at FOB Ithaca consumes the component and permanently quadruples the traverse rate of Ithaca's colossal naval turrets.

name: Naval Cycling Regulator
desc: A cryogenic timing assembly built to regulate the thermal cycle of fortress-scale beam capacitors. Installing it at FOB Ithaca consumes the component and permanently reduces Ithaca naval-beam cooldowns to 40% of their base duration.

name: Caged-Arc Projector
desc: A field projector that cages surplus beam energy before releasing it along controlled ionization paths. Installing it at FOB Ithaca consumes the component and permanently adds shield-respecting EMP arcs around Ithaca's naval beams.

name: Interception Command Matrix
desc: A distributed fire-control matrix containing targeting doctrine for saturation-defense missile arrays. Installing it at FOB Ithaca consumes the component and permanently activates Ithaca's four fixed Cloudswarm launchers and their 41-missile intercept bursts.

name: Siege Munitions Compiler
desc: A sealed fabrication compiler holding guidance and maneuvering specifications for fortress-scale torpedoes. Installing it at FOB Ithaca consumes the component and permanently converts Ithaca's base Hammer batteries into guided Atropos batteries while retaining their ten-shot salvos and station range.

name: Fortress Autoloader Core
desc: A hardened coordination core for kilometer-scale magazines and feed mechanisms. Installing it at FOB Ithaca consumes the component and permanently reduces Ithaca missile-battery refire and reload times to 40% of base and expands each Cloudswarm burst from 41 missiles to 81.
